hypothesis: Writing the lm_head's 248320 logits in device memory and copying them to the host once, instead of storing a float a warp into mapped host memory, does not lower Qwen3.6's decode on an L4 with every expert in VRAM, with the same logits
command: cd c && make qwen36_tier.o backend_cuda.o cuda_chain.o cu_xb.o cu_tier.o CUDA=1 CUDA_ARCH=sm_89 && gcc -O3 -march=native -fopenmp -pthread -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -Wno-misleading-indentation -Wno-unused-function -DCOLI_CUDA -I. ../docs/experiments/qwen36-cuda-lmhead-device-2026-10-27/bench.c qwen36_tier.o backend_cuda.o cuda_chain.o cu_xb.o cu_tier.o -o qwen36-bench -lm -fopenmp -pthread -L/usr/local/cuda/lib64 -Wl,-rpath,/usr/local/cuda/lib64 -lcudart -lcublasLt -lcublas -lstdc++; LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/lib64-nvidia COLI_CUDA=1 COLI_GPUS=0 CUDA_EXPERT_GB=auto OMP_WAIT_POLICY=ACTIVE OMP_PROC_BIND=close ./qwen36-bench --model <model> --text <dir>/promessi_sposi.txt --lengths 64,512 --gen 32 --teacher --steps /content/misura/v1-runN.steps

hardware.cpu: Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU @ 2.20GHz (12 CPUs, 38.5 MiB L3) + NVIDIA L4 (23034 MiB, sm_89)
hardware.storage: the model on the machine's local disk before the runs, then read once into the page cache

quality.method: make -C c check (macOS arm64) and make -C c cuda-chain-check cuda-test CUDA=1 CUDA_ARCH=sm_89 pass; every run of both versions gives the same fingerprint of every logit and token (FNV-1a: 1837d0374f5820c3 at 64 tokens, 9a9da81aa38cc006 at 512) and the same teacher-forced nll (2.69849 and 2.94540)
